notes.subject: אפדם אגאלם
notes.rationale: KJV/Geneva ritim olsem tok strong bilong Yahwe ('I will ransom'), tasol JPS ritim olsem askim ('Shall I ransom?') — konteks bilong kot long Efraim i sansin long askim.

notes.subject: אהי
notes.rationale: Hibru 'we' (interrogative) o 'bai i kamap' — YLT 'Where is thy plague' vs KJV 'I will be thy plagues'.

notes.subject: sik
notes.rationale: דבר em i sik nupela i kilim ol man planti (pestilence), i no 'plagues' olgeta.

notes.subject: דבר/מות · קטב/שאול
notes.rationale: Tupela pasin: nem bilong dai i tanim wantaim tok bilong bagarap — singaut nogut long dai, i lus long tanim tok.

translation: Bai mi baimbek ol long han bilong Seol; bai mi baimbek ol long dai. We pinis ol sik bilong yu, o dai? We pinis bagarap bilong yu, o Seol? Sori i stap hait long ai bilong mi.
